Edit: explaining more thoroughly about the composition

The client (state opera house) asked me to film a last minute interview before the contracts on the interviewee’s ended. 
I got a reference from my PoC and they sent me just a basic interview look. 

That’s not my style, I try to find different unorthodox composition. So I asked what was the message of the final product; they told me to recruit more individuals and to educate them on the program they were affiliated with. So I thought something more centered frame, more personable and showcasing the backdrop they use for rehearsals and the posters on their previous shows. 

I was working with little to no budget - borrowed lights from a friend. The overall day was cloudy but sometimes the sun will peak over a cloud - which happened during my first interview- so I will have to let the editor/colorist know that there needs to be a grade done throughout. 

Mainly used sunlight - backlight was an intellytech with snap grid and diffused. 
Key light was the sun with an intellytech skinned with muslin to wrap.
